unscoreable_emissions.reason: The bundled Ohio sections define 'legislative agent' qualitatively (main purpose) and require registration within ten days of engagement, but they do not set any dollar compensation threshold for registration.
The bundled Ohio sections do not provide any dollar expenditure threshold that triggers lobbyist registration; registration is tied to being engaged to actively advocate as a main purpose.

The statute defines 'legislative agent' as engaged 'during at least a portion of the individual's time' to actively advocate as 'one of the individual's main purposes' but gives no percentage-of-time threshold.

Statements of expenditures require itemization for any expenditures to particular officials (with a special $50 aggregation rule for meals), but the question asks a general itemization de minimis threshold; the statute does not set a single itemization threshold beyond the meals-specific $50 rule.
The bundled sections impose filing duties based on being a registered legislative agent/employer and on expenditure types/amounts, not on any percentage-of-time threshold for filing.
